description: This file defines the SlidingTabStrip class, a custom view used as part of a tab layout system in an Android application. It handles drawing of the tab indicator, divider lines, and bottom border, and manages tab colors and selection state.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that manages tab indicator rendering, dividers, and colors for a tab layout.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface or inner class that provides color information for indicators and dividers.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: A concrete implementation of TabColorizer that uses color arrays for indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the tab indicator, removing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets divider colors between tabs, removing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset during page scrolls.
